title: Introduction to Oil Painting
description:
Build the foundational skills to paint with confidence in this full-day Oil Painting workshop for beginners and those wanting to refine and expand their existing skill set.

Exploring simple composition and drawing to form the basis of our painting we move on to applying tonal values to create a monochromatic underpainting.

Observing the effects of light on our subject matter we translate value to colour, mixing to explore saturation and hue with attention to temperature and finally, application bringing it all together to arrive at a single session artwork.

A relaxed studio environment with a maximum six participants ensures generous individual guidance along with live demonstrations.

Apply knowledge gained from this introductory workshop and save by coupling a second day workshop (Wednesday) in Portraiture or Still Life.

title: Still Life Oil Painting
description:
For those who have some experience or wish to expand on the knowledge gained from my Introduction to Oil Painting Workshop we will venture into painting a still life composed for the day.

Focusing on intense contrast to create dramatic form and dimension we learn to capture the light, interpret values, temperature and apply colour theory to create your artwork.

All workshop equipment and supplies provided. You will take away your painted canvas.

title: Your Personalised Workshop
description:
For those seeking a personalised experience.

Spend the day working closely with me to create a unique piece of art tailored to your interests and skill level.

We will explore various techniques and approaches to ensure your artwork reflects your vision and creativity.
